findings.title: A hard link inside the allow-listed tree to an outside file passes the real-path check and is served on every route.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts openOnce. Live: hard links under ts/public/, _data/workbench/ (via /@fs) and docs/ (via /workbench-file/ with the demo flag) each returned the outside file.
findings.consequence: The guard's purpose is defeated through a different filesystem primitive with the same preconditions as the symlink case.

findings.title: The code comment listing what the guard does not cover overclaims: node_modules leaf symlinks and ?inline/?url/?worker on a symlinked file are refused by the outer middleware.
findings.consequence: A maintainer could add an early pass-through to fix a gap that does not exist and open a real one.
